verdict.rationale: Consensus's core interaction is natural language: its semantic search is built to understand questions phrased in plain language, Threads turns searches into ongoing conversations, and the research agent chains actions such as citation crawling, DOI lookup and author search on top of those queries. Missing for 10: documentation that non-search operations (library import and management, filters, exports) can be driven by natural-language commands, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Semantic search, powered by AI embeddings, to capture the intent behind your question and support natural language queries.
Threads reimagines how you interact with peer-reviewed research by turning isolated searches into flowing conversations.

Consensus has evolved from a search tool into a research agent. Citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, similar papers, and more - chained together on top of the worlds best academic search engine.
